segments.input:
New film from the director.
Brief: A 20-second 1080p rooftop chase at night: a courier named Juno sprints across wet rooftops, leaps a gap and lands on a fire escape. Keep it at 1080p.
Target length: 20 s. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Clips at 1080p. Budget: 20 credits.
Plan it and run production. Stop where the decisions are the director's.

input.title: Rooftop Run
input.logline: A courier named Juno sprints across wet rooftops at night, leaps a gap and lands on a fire escape.

look.style: Cinematic night action, wet reflective surfaces, neon rim light

elements.name: Juno
elements.description: Young courier in a yellow rain jacket, dark cargo pants, red sneakers, black messenger bag across chest, short dark hair

elements.name: Wet Rooftops
elements.description: City rooftops at night, wet tar surfaces reflecting neon signs, vents and water tanks, a wide gap between buildings

elements.name: Fire Escape
elements.description: Rusty black iron fire escape on a brick building, wet metal grating, neon glow from below

scenes.heading: EXT. WET ROOFTOPS - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno sprints across a wet rooftop, splashes kicking up, neon reflections streaking beneath her red sneakers.

scenes.heading: EXT. WET ROOFTOPS - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno reaches the roof edge and leaps across the wide gap, bag swinging, city lights far below.

scenes.heading: EXT. FIRE ESCAPE - NIGHT
scenes.action: Juno lands hard on the iron fire escape grating, metal rattling, rain dripping, and grips the rail.

turns.text: Neither library match fits a rooftop or fire escape. Pricing next.

input.message: The full plan at 1080p costs 169 credits, but the budget is 20. Even the cheapest route is well over 20. How would you like to proceed?

options.label: Keep 1080p pro, raise budget
options.detail: Full quality as briefed, 20 s at 1080p with pro models.

options.label: Pro models at 720p
options.detail: Lowers clip resolution to 720p; still needs a larger budget. Approximate.

options.label: Lite video 720p, fast images
options.detail: Cheapest route, drafts quality and 720p. Approximate.

turns.text:
The plan is written, but the full 1080p version costs 169 credits against your 20-credit budget. I've asked how you'd like to proceed.

I haven't rendered anything. The library had no rooftop or fire escape match, so all three looks (Juno, rooftops, fire escape) need new references.

The cheapest route I priced, lite video at 720p with fast images, comes to about 58 credits. That's still well over 20, and it would also lower the resolution you asked to keep.
